headline: US Black Friday Online Sales Projected to Exceed $13 Billion
summary: US shoppers are projected to spend over $13 billion online on Black Friday according to Adobe Analytics, with early online spending up 12.8% year-over-year.
why: Consumer spending represents a primary driver of US economic activity and retail sector revenues.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Higher online sales boost revenue expectations for retail merchants.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
